rv.q: This miraculously innovative show finds a new way of representing reality.

This extraordinary piece concentrates on the ground level business of patching and mending and surviving and re-defines the priorities in our everyday lives in the aftermath of one almighty blip, the bane and banality of evil.

cn.t: This verbatim musical breaks theatrical rules by transforming everyday speech into riveting music-theatre, with critics praising its complex structure and innovative approach to finding melody in ordinary conversation.
